compendium.summary: Storage, secure staging and campaign infrastructure.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Pre-cast gate: Know which existing door can be reopened and how occupants leave.
Failure state: Storage without retrieval, trapped allies, or dependence on one caster.
Safe operating default: Maintain an inventory, redundant access plan, breathable assumptions, and no unlabeled doors.
